newsitem.title: GERMANY: SIA ups ex-Germany Oct rates about 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: SIA ups ex-Germany Oct rates about 10 pct.

text.p: Singapore Airlines said it will follow the lead of Lufthansa Cargo AG and raise ex-Germany rates to Singapore this autumn.
Heinz Icha, the airline's Germany cargo manager, told Reuters: "We plan a rate increase of about 10 percent. We will increase at about the same level (as Lufthansa)."
Lufthansa Cargo said on Monday it will raise ex-Germany air cargo rates by up to 10 percent to Singapore, Bangkok and Hong Kong from October 1.
"We expect that in the autumn the market will grow as it traditionally does from the end of September," Icha said.

He noted that Singapore Airlines has twice-weekly Boeing 747 freighter services from Frankfurt in joint venture with Lufthansa, with each airline operating one of the two flights, as well as daily B747-400 passenger services.
Questioned on the summer price war in Germany, Icha said: "We have tried to keep the rates stable over the summer but we have not been able to do so."
The airline is satisfied with current load factors, however, he said.
